WORKFORCE / SKI RESORTS

Staff rooms on resort land,
built between seasons.

For ski resort operators and mountain towns.

Furnished private rooms with their own bath for seasonal and year-round staff. Set on ground screws that level each unit on a slope.

Start a conversationSee the units

THE PROBLEM

Resorts can hire the staff. They cannot house them.

Mountain towns rent to visitors, and seasonal staff arrive all at once. A resort that can offer a room near the lifts fills its roster. One that cannot turns people away.

HOW RESORTS USE IT

Private rooms, close to the lifts.

Where
Resort land: base areas, lots and maintenance yards.
Who
Lift, ski school, patrol and food crews, plus year-round staff.
Rooms
Private rooms recruit better than dorms. The shared layout puts two twin beds in one unit.
Slopes
Ground screws level each unit on sloped, uneven ground. No slab to pour.
All year
Summer and operations staff use the same rooms.

PLAN AROUND THE SEASON

Scope in spring. Build in summer.

  • Spring

    Scope

    Site review, unit mix and approvals while the mountain is still running.

  • Summer

    Build

    Ground screws in, then panels and bath pods set.

  • Fall

    Move in

    Rooms furnished ahead of seasonal hiring and training.

  • Next summer

    Add rows

    Grow the cluster with the same units and panels.

Schedules, roofs and snow loads are engineered and confirmed for each site.
